subject: Initial mutual success plan + evaluation timeline for Zetta
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Cho <sam.cho@vertexlogistics.com>, Olivia Porter <olivia.porter@zetta-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Initial mutual success plan + evaluation timeline for Zetta

Hi Sam / Olivia —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. As discussed, I've attached a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template and sketched an initial evaluation timeline so we can align on milestones and owners. Key goals for this MAP:

- Establish a 6-week technical evaluation with clear acceptance criteria
- Define security and procurement checkpoints early so they don't block the pilots
- Capture responsibilities (Zetta vs Redwood) and decision date for go/no-go

What I'm proposing next:
1) You review the attached MAP-template and add any missing milestones by EOD Mon (Apr 5).
2) We'll co-edit the Google Doc I created and lock owners by Apr 7.
3) Kick off the first technical review week of Apr 13.

Attachments: [MAP-template-redwood-v1.docx (docx)]
Google Doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xz-zetta-mutual-plan-draft

If that timeline looks tight, call it out and we'll shift — my priority is to make procurement/security timelines explicit so we can avoid surprises.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference
From: Sam Cho <sam.cho@vertexlogistics.com>

Cc: security@zetta-corp.com
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2026 11:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial mutual success plan + evaluation timeline for Zetta

Rishi —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear next steps. Couple quick notes from our side:

- The 6-week window is fine, but procurement will need an approved SOW and pricing by Apr 20 to meet our internal quarter planning. Can Redwood give a committed not-to-exceed pricing sheet by Apr 16?
- Security wants the questionnaire answered before the first technical review. I attached the checklist they provided — it’s short but includes a request for SOC2 evidence and data retention details.
- Suggest we shift lock-on-owners date to Apr 9 to give our security and procurement folks time.

Also: Olivia will be the internal PM for the evaluation and will own sign-off. Looping her in as a primary contact.

Attachments: [zetta-security-attachment-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

Sam
Sam Cho
Director of Integrations, Vertex Logistics (client)

Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Zetta MAP — security questionnaire + owners

Team —

Sam pushed back the owners lock date to Apr 9 and security wants the questionnaire answered before the technical review. Action items:

- Marissa: can you own the pricing SOW by Apr 16 and prepare a not-to-exceed sheet we can hand to procurement?
- Dev: please prepare a short technical onboarding checklist and a stub for the pilot environment (expected start Apr 13). Can you confirm whether we need an additional on-prem packaging note for their regulated cluster?
- Priyom: I’ll need you to respond to the SOC2 and retention questions — I’ve attached the checklist. Put together a one-page summary we can send to security by Apr 6.

I’m going to update the Google Doc with these proposed owners and a conservative timeline. We want to be proactive: if procurement needs a contract amendment early, loop legal — Marissa, please coordinate.

Thanks,
Rishi

[Attachment: zetta-security-attachment-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2026 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated MAP draft & next steps (owners locked for draft)

Sam / Olivia —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I updated the MAP Google Doc and attached an exported docx for your procurement team to review. Changes made per your asks:

- Owners locked in the draft: Olivia (internal PM), Marissa (procurement/SOW), Dev (technical onboarding), Priyom (security responses)
- Updated milestone: owners locked by Apr 9; draft SOW + pricing to procurement by Apr 16; pilot start Apr 13 (technical prep to begin Apr 8)
- Added a short acceptance criteria section for the pilot (latency targets, integration smoke tests, data handling confirmation)

Links and files:
- MAP (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xz-zetta-mutual-plan-draft
- Exported MAP (for procurement): [MAP-template-redwood-v1.docx (docx)]
- Security checklist we received: [zetta-security-attachment-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

Next asks for Zetta: please confirm the internal PM (Olivia) and the procurement contact who will receive the SOW by Apr 9 so we can route the pricing sheet and legal draft. If you prefer, we can run a 30-min alignment call Apr 7 to walk the MAP and sign-off criteria.

Appreciate the collaboration — looking forward to starting the pilot.

Best,
